biography: Preconstruction professional that specializes in complex, challenging projects and delivering them successfully to meet the client's goals and bringing great value to the team throughout the process. I proudly bring over 27 years of experience in the industry, delivering more than 40 million sf of Healthcare, Higher Education, Data Center, Hi-Rise Multifamily, Mixed Use, Retail, Corporate Office, Cultural, Municipal, and Hospitality space to our clients. My involvement begins in the early napkin-sketch-stage all the way through project completion. Specialties Preconstruction Management, Design-Build, LEAN, LEED AP BD+C, Cost Analysis, Conceptual Budgeting, GMP Development, Subcontract Negotiation & Buyout, 3D Conceptual Modeling and Estimating Using DProfiler Software, Destini Estimator, Timberline, Revit and Assemble.
